biography.plain_text: Gregg Ostrander is an American food-industry executive who led Michael Foods as chief executive and chairman. He joined the Minnesota processor after running Armour Swift-Eckrich's prepared-foods division. As a significant shareholder, he participated with private-equity partners in management buyouts that developed the company's egg, refrigerated potato and branded dairy businesses.

long_biography.plain_text:
Food executive Gregg Ostrander studied marketing at the University of Wisconsin–Madison, graduating with distinction before beginning his career with Swiss Miss. Away from business, he became a youth mentor and coach and helped raise funds for the Red Cross. He also learned to fly, earning his pilot's licence in 2007, alongside interests in golf and skiing.

With Kristin Ostrander, he serves as a trustee of a charitable trust bearing their names. Its grants have supported organisations including the Neighborhood Health Clinic, Youth Haven and Utah Chamber Artists. The couple have also supported the Wisconsin School of Business.
